item.title: Botulinum Neurotoxin Injection Improves Sleep in Cervical Dystonia
item.description: In cervical dystonia botulinum neurotoxin injections improved sleep quality but did not ease anxiety or depression in adult cohort. The post Botulinum Neurotoxin Injection Improves Sleep in Cervical Dystonia appeared first on European Medical Journal.

item.title: MRIs Reveal Brain Structure Changes After Second Pregnancy
item.description: Women experience unique changes in brain structure after a second pregnancy, MRIs have revealed in a 2026 cohort study. The post MRIs Reveal Brain Structure Changes After Second Pregnancy appeared first on European Medical Journal.

item.title: Transplant Oncology Expands Liver Transplant Options
item.description: Transplant oncology is expanding liver transplantation for some cancers pairing downstaging therapy with strict selection criteria. The post Transplant Oncology Expands Liver Transplant Options appeared first on European Medical Journal.

item.title: New Blood Test Identifies Serious Scarring in Liver Disease
item.description: A new blood test accurately identifies serious scarring in patients with liver disease, a 2026 cohort study has found. The post New Blood Test Identifies Serious Scarring in Liver Disease appeared first on European Medical Journal.

item.title: Getting Over the AMR Hump with Camel Antimicrobial Peptides
item.description: Researchers uncover three antimicrobial peptides in dromedary camels that show potent activity against multidrug-resistant bacteria. The post Getting Over the AMR Hump with Camel Antimicrobial Peptides appeared first on European Medical Journal.

item.title: Blood Test Could Predict Alzheimer’s Disease Onset
item.description: The authors concluded that the time until onset of Alzheimer’s disease symptoms could be estimated using a single blood test within a margin of error that may be acceptable for use in clinical trials. The post Blood Test Could Predict Alzheimer’s Disease Onset appeared first on European Medical Journal.

item.title: UK pharma M&A stalled, biotech thrived in 2025
item.description: A new report suggests biotech took the lead in UK healthcare M&A in 2025, outpacing pharma and life sciences. The post UK pharma M&A stalled, biotech thrived in 2025 appeared first on European Medical Journal.

item.title: Minimal Disease Activity Sustained in Atopic Dermatitis
item.description: Most early responders with atopic dermatitis sustain minimal disease activity at one year, with baseline factors predicting long-term control. The post Minimal Disease Activity Sustained in Atopic Dermatitis appeared first on European Medical Journal.

item.title: CCN5 Protein Prevents Cardiac Cellular Senescence
item.description: The team demonstrated that CCN5 effectively inhibited doxorubicin-induced cardiac cellular senescence in both cardiac myoblasts and fibroblasts. The post CCN5 Protein Prevents Cardiac Cellular Senescence appeared first on European Medical Journal.
